facts.text: I have a spider plant with new growth that I think needs to be fertilized soon.
On the same day, I pruned some dead leaves from my snake plant.
I am considering getting a humidifier for my plants.
I want a humidifier especially for my fern and peace lily because they seem to thrive in humid environments.
I am thinking of propagating a new succulent from a leaf cutting.
My succulent leaf cutting has been sitting in water for three weeks.
I have an African violet that has been struggling with spider mites.
I attended a houseplant workshop recently where I learned about using neem oil to deal with spider mites.
I have a basil plant and I am using a general-purpose potting mix for it.
I have heard that basil prefers a more well-draining potting mix.
I recently bought a new Phalaenopsis orchid.
I want to use an orchid potting mix designed specifically for orchids for my Phalaenopsis orchid.
